testimonials.author: Ayesha K.
testimonials.quote: They always have what I need in stock, and the pharmacist actually explains how to take everything. Never rushed.

testimonials.author: Bilal R.
testimonials.quote: Called them at 10 PM for my father's medicine and they delivered it within the hour. Genuinely reliable.

testimonials.quote: Our go-to for anything from baby formula to BP checks. It genuinely feels like a family pharmacy.
